entries.sql:
WITH __mrr_movements AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    starting_mrr,
    ending_mrr
  FROM nl_assistant_db.analytics.mrr_movements
), monthly AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    starting_mrr,
    ending_mrr
  FROM __mrr_movements
  WHERE
    month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01'
  ORDER BY
    month
), summary AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(starting_mrr) AS jan_starting_mrr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2025-12-01' THEN ending_mrr END) AS dec_ending_mrr
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  m.month,
  m.starting_mrr,
  m.ending_mrr,
  s.jan_starting_mrr AS starting_mrr_jan_2025,
  s.dec_ending_mrr AS ending_mrr_dec_2025,
  s.dec_ending_mrr - s.jan_starting_mrr AS mrr_growth_2025,
  CASE
    WHEN s.jan_starting_mrr <> 0
    THEN (
      s.dec_ending_mrr - s.jan_starting_mrr
    ) / NULLIF(s.jan_starting_mrr, 0)
  END AS mrr_growth_pct_2025
FROM monthly AS m
CROSS JOIN summary AS s
ORDER BY
  m.month
;

WITH __mrr_movements AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    net_revenue_retention_pct
  FROM nl_assistant_db.analytics.mrr_movements
), __anomaly_flags AS (
  SELECT
    anomaly_status,
    month
  FROM nl_assistant_db.analytics.anomaly_flags
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.net_revenue_retention_pct) AS avg_net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM __mrr_movements AS m
INNER JOIN __anomaly_flags AS a
  ON m.month = a.month
WHERE
  a.anomaly_status = 'flagged' AND m.month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
;
